argument_macro_structure.dominant_argument_form: Dialectical challenge-and-revision structure: reconstructs the orthodox Davidsonian model, introduces Hursthouse's counterexamples, deepens the challenge through phenomenological distinctions, addresses normative objections, and concludes with a revised framework of intentionality.
argument_macro_structure.premise_explicitness: Moderately explicit; premises are embedded in phenomenological descriptions and dialectical contrasts rather than formalized syllogisms.

argumentative_quality.dialectical_reasonableness: High; the essay engages with both cognitivist and deflationary objections and attempts to show why they fail.
argumentative_quality.logical_relevance: All major sections contribute directly to the central thesis; no irrelevant digressions.
argumentative_quality.premise_acceptability: The phenomenological premises are plausible but contestable; the normative bridge relies on diachronic responsibility assumptions.

distinctions_drawn: synchronic practical reasoning vs diachronic character stewardship

dialectical_engagement.objection_handling: The essay anticipates and responds to the objection that arational actions collapse into reflexes by appealing to executive motor control and contextual responsiveness.
objections_raised: Exculpation threat: if arational actions lack beliefs/desires, agents seem not morally responsible.
Deflationary collapse: arational actions might be mere reflexes or spasms.
Cognitivist reduction: hidden beliefs/desires might still be present.

epistemic_stance_and_voice.certainty_language_frequency: Low; the essay uses hedged, exploratory language ('appears', 'seems', 'must examine') rather than dogmatic assertions.

method_and_evidence.evidence_type: Phenomenological description, counterexamples, conceptual analysis, normative thought experiments.

philosophical_orientation.grounding: Phenomenology of emotional experience and philosophy of action
philosophical_orientation.sentiment: Sympathetic to Hursthouse; critical of Davidsonian orthodoxy

structural_organization.structure_type: Problem-solution with progressive deepening; sections move from exposition to challenge to normative resolution to conceptual revision.

summary_of_core_decisions: The essay ultimately endorses a dual conception of intentionality: rational (belief-desire driven) and arational (emotion-driven, expressive). It preserves moral responsibility by shifting focus from local choice to diachronic emotional self-governance.

thesis_commitment.hedging_density_in_final_paragraph: Low; the conclusion is assertive and confident.
